title: Two-By-Two Value Formula
body_html:
Two-By-Two Value Formula

For a two-by-two matrix $$ \begin{pmatrix} a & b\\ c & d \end{pmatrix}, $$ either there is a pair of pure optimal strategies, or the optimal strategies are completely mixed and the value is $$ \frac{ad-bc}{a+d-b-c}. $$

References

  • [MFoGT, Ex. 2.6.3] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Value formula for two-by-two matrix games.
